gameLoopReview.evidence: Implementation health is strong, but docs/PLAYTESTS is absent; empirical confidence is low and no player outcome is fabricated.
prioritizedFindings: The repo has no current structured playtest evidence lane; the Session 55 QA checklist is stale relative to action-observed onboarding.
DeathScreen contains a strong RUN THE FIX action but repeats multiple competing replay, rematch, share, leaderboard, play-again, and exit actions.
Progression and pressure systems are mechanically rich but do not preserve a source-derived runway or run-level pressure arc for calibration.
nextThreeMoves: Instrument opt-in, local-only first-run receipts without pretending synthetic data is playtest evidence.
Make one derived next move primary and progressively disclose all secondary post-run actions.
Persist deterministic progression and pressure receipts before tuning balance from real distributions.

items.title: Create an opt-in local playtest flight recorder that turns observed first-run behavior and explicit tester judgments into a portable, privacy-safe receipt.
items.why: docs/PLAYTESTS does not exist, docs/QA_CHECKLIST.md still describes obsolete timer-driven onboarding, and active assumptions about chaos readability, replay intent, and humor have no current participant evidence. Automated screenshots are not player-behavior evidence.
items.recipe: Add a zero-network playtest session contract enabled only by ?playtest=1; record bounded milestone timing from existing command evidence, death/run facts, the selected continuation action, and explicit clarity/replay-intent answers; persist only in sessionStorage and expose a sanitized JSON copy/export card on DeathScreen.

L1.recipe: Define and test a sanitized playtest receipt schema plus opt-in detection.

L2.recipe: Wire run start, first move/shot/kill, death, and continuation milestones through existing command/death paths.

L3.recipe: Add explicit death-clarity and replay-intent prompts, portable JSON copy, reset semantics, privacy copy, and cross-run regression coverage.

items.title: Preserve each run's pressure arc so the debrief can distinguish a sudden overrun from sustained pressure instead of discarding wave-director evidence after telemetry emission.
items.why: App.jsx emits wave_pressure_band only when a band changes, but createRunHistoryEntry receives no pressure evidence. Local Balance Lab and post-run intelligence therefore cannot connect the collapse to the live director arc.
items.recipe: Add a bounded pure pressure-arc accumulator, record band transitions from existing wave telemetry, finalize a sanitized max-ratio/transition/collapse-band receipt at death, preserve it in run history, and surface one observed-only debrief line without causal claims.

L1.recipe: Add the pure accumulator/finalizer with invariant tests.

L2.recipe: Wire transitions into App and persist the normalized receipt in run history.

L3.recipe: Use the receipt in Balance Lab and DeathScreen with bounded history, migration-safe normalization, and observed-only wording.

items.title: Unify account levels, weapon unlocks, career-point earnings, and permanent-upgrade costs into a deterministic progression runway contract before any curve tuning.
items.why: getAccountLevel uses sqrt(totalKills/20), kills award career points, weapon unlock levels live separately, and META_UPGRADES span 200-3500 points. No shared simulator or invariant states when milestones become reachable, so curve edits cannot be reviewed coherently.
items.recipe: Extract the pure account-level contract, build a source-derived runway simulator for configurable kills-per-run scenarios, emit next weapon/upgrade milestones from current career state, integrate descriptive evidence into Balance Lab, and test monotonicity and exact thresholds without inventing target retention claims.

L1.recipe: Extract getAccountLevel into a pure utility and preserve storage API compatibility.

L2.recipe: Add simulator and milestone invariants across weapons/upgrades.

L3.recipe: Integrate a descriptive runway receipt into Balance Lab and add a deterministic audit CLI for future real-data calibration.

items.title: Publish a versioned, source-derived gameplay contract so AI agents can inspect modes, weapons, unlocks, trust scope, and challenge-link grammar without scraping prose.
items.why: public/agents.json exposes only game.describe and links to prose/legal resources. No machine-readable gameplay resource exists, even though the project explicitly serves humans and AI agents and its mechanics already live in importable constants.
items.recipe: Generate public/gameplay-contract.json from source constants at build time; include bounded public-safe mechanics and explicit advisory replay scope; link it from agents.json and llms.txt; make the public-contract validator recompute and compare the artifact so it cannot silently drift.

L1.recipe: Define schema and generate modes/weapons/unlock metadata.

L2.recipe: Add enemies/bosses/challenge grammar and explicit trust/cost/rights scope.

L3.recipe: Wire build generation, exact drift validation, agent/LLM discovery links, and regression tests.

items.title: Turn RUN THE FIX into one derived post-death continuation decision and progressively disclose every secondary action without deleting player agency.
items.why: DeathScreen already computes a nextRunDrill and renders its primary CTA, then later presents Play Again, Replay Seed, Rematch, Share Run, Leaderboard, and Rage Quit together. The duplicated decision surface creates a verified hierarchy conflict even though its behavioral effect is not yet measured.
items.recipe: Create a pure continuation plan from the existing drill/seed/rematch state, use it for one primary next-run action, move proof/replay/rematch/share/navigation alternatives behind an accessible More Options disclosure, and retain direct keyboard/controller reachability plus distinct analytics events.

L1.recipe: Add a pure continuation-plan builder and tests.

L2.recipe: Unify primary action behavior and progressively disclose duplicate run actions.

L3.recipe: Add accessible summary/focus semantics, preserve all alternatives, and connect the choice to the playtest receipt.

skipped.reason: Rejected: disabling manual NEXT would silently reverse the Session 127 accessibility decision that manual Next/Skip remain available. Observed evidence should inform receipts, not trap players.

False premise found during implementation inspection: the secondary seed/replay/rematch/share/navigation cluster already lives inside an accessible MORE RUN ACTIONS disclosure, while RUN THE FIX is already the standalone primary action. The valid playtest-choice receipt was implemented under playtest-flight-recorder; no redundant hierarchy rewrite was shipped.
Rejected: no real playtest distribution supports changing upgrade prices, weapon levels, or points-per-kill. Instrument and model first.
Rejected under CANON-029 and CANON-039: existing deterministic Run Brain is zero-cost and no paid inference need is proven.
External credential/scope gate: analytics capability is MISSING and the available Sentry DSN is not proven project-scoped.
Release gate is NO-GO due external/manual/data/publication/founder evidence. No launch state will be fabricated.
No live dependency or browser security premise justified another package; current security/public gates pass and Internal-First forbids install-for-appearance.
